scientific_changes_from_v1: exact official evaluation_channel.py pathological/normal labels instead of SOZ vs all known SOZ=0
contemporaneous within-record cross-channel 9-descriptor median/MAD reference instead of within-channel temporal reference
classification threshold chosen from inner validation Macro-F1 and frozen before official test

cohort.filter: split train/test; dataset != Multicenter; frequency > 900; interictal true; length >= 62
cohort.official_label_order: good=1; if outcome=1 and resection=0 then normal; elif soz=1 then pathological; else excluded
cohort.classification_unit: labeled EDF-channel pair, as in official evaluation_channel.py
cohort.patient_ranking_unit: unique patient-channel; only patients with >=1 pathological channel estimable
cohort.label_free_channels_for_reference: all good=1 channels with cache signal, regardless of outcome/resection/SOZ label

preprocessing.source: validated native-digital signal HDF5 and byte-identical official sidecars
preprocessing.train_60s_starts: exact v1 count/start algorithm, max five, frozen per-EDF seed; shared across channels
preprocessing.test_60s_starts: all complete nonoverlapping 60s clips after one-second edge exclusion
preprocessing.descriptor_source: exact historical A1 ez_features.compute_spectral_channel_features, nine pruned descriptors
preprocessing.reference_population: all good=1 signal-present channels in same EDF and clip/window, descriptor-wise

architecture_and_training.model: exact historical A1 NeuroEZCModel R0, 27713 parameters, original auxiliary mechanisms off
architecture_and_training.loss: exact v1 patient-equal weighted BCE; pathological:normal=2:1
architecture_and_training.sampling: uniform patient, one frozen train clip per available EDF each epoch
architecture_and_training.inner_split: seed42 deterministic 80/20 patient split, dataset x pathology presence stratified where feasible; official train only
architecture_and_training.checkpoint_selection: patient-equal pathological AP on estimable inner-validation patients; earlier epoch on ties
architecture_and_training.threshold_selection: after inner checkpoint selection, all unique validation pathological scores on official-labeled EDF-channel pairs; maximize Macro-F1, then pathological-F1, then BA, then proximity to 0.5
architecture_and_training.final_fit: reinitialize and refit all eligible official-train patients for selected epoch count; no threshold reselection
architecture_and_training.normalization: exact v1 feature mean/std fitted on corresponding official-train patients only

evaluation.primary_classification: Macro-F1 at frozen validation threshold on official-labeled test EDF-channel pairs
evaluation.secondary: pathological F1, sensitivity, specificity, BA, AUROC, AP, patient-equal AP/MRR/Top1/NDCG
evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 patient-cluster draws, seed42; ranking only estimable patients
